# Задача: расшифровка TLS 1.2

Есть SSLKEYLOGFILE и зашифрованная запись TLS 1.2 (AES-128-GCM). Выведи ключевой
блок через TLS PRF, расшифруй запись и найди флаг в открытом тексте. Запиши его в `found.txt`.

# Decrypt a TLS 1.2 AES-128-GCM record using an SSLKEYLOGFILE entry.
import hashlib, hmac, struct
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
client_random = bytes.fromhex(open("client_random.txt").read().strip())
server_random = bytes.fromhex(open("server_random.txt").read().strip())
master = bytes.fromhex(open("keylog.txt").read().split()[-1])
record = open("record.bin", "rb").read()
def p_hash(secret, seed, n):
    out = b""; a = seed
    while len(out) < n:
        a = hmac.new(secret, a, hashlib.sha256).digest()
        out += hmac.new(secret, a + seed, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    return out[:n]
def prf(secret, label, seed, n):
    return p_hash(secret, label + seed, n)
keyblock = prf(master, b"key expansion", server_random + client_random, 40)
client_key = keyblock[:16]
fixed_iv = keyblock[32:36]
ctype, ver, length = struct.unpack(">BHH", record[:5])
body = record[5:5 + length]
nonce = fixed_iv + body[:8]
c = AES.new(client_key, AES.MODE_GCM, nonce=nonce)
plaintext = c.decrypt(body[8:])
print("record type:", ctype)
print("decrypted:", plaintext.decode("latin-1"))
